A community-curated checklist

Pokémon cards withreflections

Explore Pokémon TCG cards with reflections in mirrors, glass, and water. This cross-artist checklist separates clear self-reflections from other reflective scenes, and lets you track cards by Pokémon, set, or illustrator.

🪞 Clear reflections · 22💧 Related scenes · 13🗂️ 35 cards · 28 sets

HOW THIS CHECKLIST IS CURATED

Two ways reflections appear

Clear self-reflections
The Pokémon’s own image is visible in a mirror, glass, or reflective water.

Related reflection scenes
Reflections shape the art, but the Pokémon’s own image may not be clearly shown.

A visual, community-built list inspired by a collector’s reflection-card post on Threads, with more ideas from the Staiz Reflections gallery and collector discussion. Card fit is subjective; a card name, set, and number make future additions easier to verify.
